answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 67 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh army of identities has no way to grade its own output. The summit register is checked at draw time, quartz lists the eligible set, and yarrow seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 67 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary forfeits for every seat it wants. That is 34 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
